errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the x-axis has a linear scale. While the tick marks are evenly spaced, the values (16, 32, 64, 128, 256) follow a logarithmic (base 2) progression, not a linear one.
The MoHD line starts at a value of approximately 10.4 for 16 sub-dims, which is visibly below the 10.5 gridline. Stating it starts at 'around 10.5' is inaccurate.
